verdict.rationale: The CLI explicitly 'drives the same backend as the desktop app' and the SDK/MCP server/OpenAPI spec expose workspaces, tasks, projects, automations, terminals, and agent orchestration programmatically, with runtime probes confirming a live hosted MCP server and full OpenAPI 3.1 schema. Missing for 10: explicit line-item confirmation that UI-only surfaces (Design element-picker, PR-review diff selection, phone app, live diff viewer) have full API equivalents, and independent/hands-on confirmation of complete parity.
